policy.reasonNoNewFetch: 两个主审计菜品在 Supabase 中均已有两个启用来源的完整 document、五类 chunk 和可追溯 evidence package；现有证据足以回答全部单位、用油和加料顺序问题。

limitations: 本轮没有重新抓取网站；所有页面事实来自 Supabase 当前 document、既有 evidence package 和既有研究记录。这样避免对已成功来源重复抓取或重复向量化。
豆果干煸四季豆的页面正文已完整读取，但其原料表没有给出步骤所用食用油、清水和鸡精的用量；报告只记录这一缺口，不从另一变体借值。
公制建议区分理论精确换算、适合发布的舍入值和来源自带公制值；来源自带公制值优先。
固体体积量没有统一密度，报告不把花生、肉末、芝士、面粉、糖或香料的杯/匙量擅自换成克。

conversionPolicy.dryMeasureCaution: 花生、肉末、芝士、面粉、糖、香料等固体的 cup/tablespoon/teaspoon 不能仅凭体积可靠换算为克；除非来源给出重量，否则保留体积单位或另找同一启用来源的明确称重证据，不推测密度。

ingredientsRaw: 2 tablespoons oil ((any neutral oil, such as canola, vegetable, or avocado oil))
sourceStepInstructions: Cut your pork belly into 3/4-inch thick pieces. Add them to a medium pot and cover with water. Bring the water to a boil, and boil for about 1 minute, or just until the pork turns opaque. This removes impurities and starts the cooking process. Take the pork out of the pot, rinse, and set it aside. Discard the water and clean out your pot.
Over low heat, add the oil and sugar to your wok or pot. Melt the sugar, and add the pork. Raise the heat to medium, and cook until the pork is lightly browned.
Reduce the heat to low, and add the wine. Cook for 2 minutes, then add the soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and water.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for about 45 minutes to 1 hour, until pork is fork tender. Every 5-10 minutes, stir to prevent burning and add more water if it gets too dry.
Once the pork is fork tender, if there is still a lot of visible liquid, uncover the wok, turn up the heat, and stir continuously until the sauce has reduced to a glistening coating.

steps.instruction: Cut the pork belly into 3/4-inch thick pieces, cover with water, boil about 1 minute until opaque, rinse, discard the blanching water, and clean the pot.
Over low heat add the oil and sugar; melt the sugar, add the pork, raise to medium, and brown lightly.
Reduce to low, add Shaoxing wine, cook 2 minutes, then add soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and water.
Cover and simmer 45-60 minutes until fork tender; stir every 5-10 minutes and add more water only if too dry.
If liquid remains, uncover, raise heat, and stir continuously until reduced to a glossy coating.

neutralOil.chineseRecommendation: 中性食用油，可选低芥酸菜籽油、普通植物油或牛油果油。这里的“中性”指气味和风味较淡，不会明显盖过糖色、绍兴酒和酱油。

additionsByStep: 第1步：五花肉加清水没过，仅用于焯煮；焯肉水随后倒掉。
第2步：先下30毫升中性油和糖，小火融糖，再下焯好的五花肉；随后转中火上色。
第3步：先加约80毫升绍兴酒，煮2分钟；再加30毫升生抽、15毫升老抽和约480-720毫升清水。
第4步：焖煮期间每5-10分钟检查；只有锅中太干时才补少量水。
第5步：不再加料，揭盖提高火力收汁。

ingredientsRaw: 带皮五花肉 一斤半左右
sourceStepInstructions: 选择肥瘦相间的带皮五花肉，洗净控干，切成小块。
不放油，将肉块平铺在锅中，逐面煎至四面金黄并煎出油脂，盛出。
保留锅内油，放入冰糖反复炒至微红，把煎好的五花肉倒回翻炒；放姜片、八角、香叶和可选干辣椒继续翻炒，加入花雕酒去腥提鲜。
加入生抽和老抽调味上色，不另加盐。
加入没过肉的开水，盖盖小火慢炖40至60分钟。
最后大火翻拌收汁，保留浓稠挂汁，不要炒干。
装盘食用。

sourceStepInstructions: Heat your wok over high heat until just starting to smoke, and add the green beans and salt. Immediately lower the heat to medium low, and sear the green beans for about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. You want to see small scorch marks on the green beans. During this process, gather the rest of the ingredients and have them ready. Once the beans are somewhat tender, take them out of the wok and set aside.
Heat the oil in your wok over medium high heat and brown the pork. Add the garlic and chili, and stir for 30 seconds. Add the sui mi ya cai, and stir everything together. Cook for another minute.
Toss in the seared green beans, cooking wine, soy sauce, sugar, and sesame oil. Crank the heat back up to high and stir-fry for a final minute. Serve immediately.

keyConclusions: 红烧肉的2汤匙中性油建议写30毫升，中性油可用低芥酸菜籽油、普通植物油或牛油果油；1/3 US cup绍兴酒建议约80毫升；五花肉约680克，肉块约1.9厘米或约2厘米。
红烧肉当前是完整的 The Woks of Life 变体，不是与豆果不焯水、不加外油变体的混合。
干煸四季豆当前是完整的 The Woks of Life 变体：先无油煸豆角，再加约30毫升油炒肉末，最后加5毫升芝麻油；不是豆果先放油素炒版的混合。
豆果干煸四季豆页面已完整读取，但自身原料表没有列出步骤中的油、水和鸡精；这些缺口不能用另一来源的数值补齐。
固体体积单位不能用通用液体换算直接变成克；报告只对重量、长度和明确液体给出公制建议。
